method: Visual inspection of the published chart image (data/digitized/ramesh-2013/figure5-weight.jpg); NOT pixel-calibrated digitization. Grouped bar chart, 3 cigarette-position bars per puff-condition, gridded y-axis 0.150-0.250g (truncated, does not start at 0). Bar shading (white=inactive cigarette smoked in that position, dark=active cigarette smoked in that position) was cross-checked against the condition_detail in sources/studies.json (active puffs always smoked before inactive; 0 puffs=3 inactive, 2 puffs=1 active+2 inactive, 4 puffs=2 active+1 inactive, 6 puffs=3 active) and matches exactly.
confidence: moderate-high -- bars are cleanly separated, axis is gridded, shading pattern independently cross-validated against the known condition structure.
unit: grams (pre/post smoking weight difference per cigarette)
cross_check: Significance pattern (2puffs-cig1 **, 4puffs-cig1 **, 4puffs-cig2 **, 6puffs-cig2 **, 6puffs-cig3 *) matches the exact text-reported comparisons in content/claims.json (ramesh-2013-cigarette-weight-self-titration) exactly.
